title: Avoid column type dispatch uppercase allocation
description: Replace coerce_value_to_column_type's type-name to_ascii_uppercase allocation with direct ASCII case-insensitive matching helpers.

criteria: Column-value coercion no longer allocates uppercase data type strings for dispatch
Integer, float, decimal, boolean, date, timestamp, interval, and text type recognition remains case-insensitive
Parameterized and prefix-based type names remain recognized
Unknown type names still return the original value unchanged
Scalar type and COPY coercion regressions pass

notes: coerce_value_to_column_type now trims the type name and dispatches directly against ASCII case-insensitive helper predicates.
Existing is_integer_type_name, is_float_type_name, and is_decimal_type_name remain available to other modules while accepting case-insensitive input.
Coercion implementations and SQL-visible error text are unchanged.
